Stoneybrook Drive Retaining Wall Replacement

Project Information

The Stoneybrook Drive Retaining Wall Replacement project is now complete.  The work included removal of cattails along the north side of the pond and removal of the old wood wall, which was replaced with a new block wall behind the properties at 5524 and 5444 Stoneybrook Drive. 

Timeline:

  • Construction Start: November 2025
  • Construction Completion: April 2026. 


Background:

The existing retaining wall is located along the south side of the properties with addresses 5524, 5444, 5414 Stoneybrook Drive in the Aspen Creek subdivision.  This wall provides support for the soil just outside the backyard fence line at these properties.  The integrity of this retaining wall is crucial in supporting the soil and backyards above the wall.  The work is necessary to prevent major failure of the wall and the surrounding ground at the residential properties.  Failure would also negatively affect the holding capacity of the stormwater retention pond.
